minutes_text:
LA VERNE YOUTH & FAMILY ACTION COMMITTEE
  Minutes of the Regular Meeting
  November 28, 2023

1. A meeting of the Youth & Family Action Committee was called to order by Chair
  Rick Crosby at 6:30 p.m.

  Executive Board Members present:

  Executive Board
  Rick Crosby, YFAC Chair, Council Member
  Wendy Lau, YFAC Vice Chair, Mayor Pro Tem
  Denise Fisher, Resident
  Don Kendrick, Resident

2. Review of Minutes  Minutes for the October 24, 2023, meeting were
  approved.

3. SRO Report  Student Resource Officer (SRO) Eduardo Burgos
  discussed continuing patrols of schools during the
  drop off time. He shared about the softball game
  between Bonita High, the La Verne Fire
  Department and the La Verne Police Department.
  The recent achievement of YFAC member Nathan
  Kwan for his perfect score on the AP Computer
  Science test was reported and celebrated by the
  group. SRO Burgos talked about the expansion of
  the explorer program and how the program helps
  build confidence, public speaking skills, and team
  building for students.

4. BUSD Report  Mark Rodgers from BUSD reported about the
  success of the first semester of the school year
  including strong enrollment and attendance. Mark
  shared about the Career Tech Education Counselor
  at the district and the work that they are doing to
  hold specialized fairs for students interested in
  skilled trades.

5. Tri-City Mental Health  Sara Rodriguez from Tri-City Mental Health
  Services (Tri-City MHS) presented to the group
  about the Mental Health Services Act (MHSA) and
  how it affects Tri-City’s funding and programs. She
  also shared a high-level overview of the services
  and programs offered by Tri-City Mental Health to
  the La Verne community. Ms. Rodriguez
 Youth & Family Action Committee Minutes October 24, 2023, page 2

  encouraged the committee to participate in the
  Community Planning Process survey that Tri-City
  MHS is currently holding.

6. Program Development  Assistant City Manager JR Ranells provided the
  group with an update on the new grant program. The
  committee discussed how to focus the grant, the
  scope of the grant, and how much each individual
  award should be. The committee voted to set aside
  $10,000 of YFAC funds and approve “up to $2,000”
  per award toward the program with all present
  members voting yes.

7. Cancellation of Dec. Meeting The committee agreed to cancel the December 26,
  2023 meeting.

8. Public Comment  Mark Rodgers shared that he will be retiring from
  BUSD at the end of the school year and will be
  helping to find a new BUSD representative to attend
  YFAC moving forward.

9. Next Meeting  The next YFAC meeting was scheduled for January
  23, 2024.

10. Adjournment  The meeting was adjourned at 7:39 p.m.

Respectfully submitted,

Erin Beilstein
Management Analyst
